frequency_question: What proportion of comparable multi-year observation windows for major emerging market central banks feature the deployment of an incremental or secondary reserve ratio tool?
membership_rule: Members are central banks of major emerging economies (e.g., India, Brazil, Indonesia, South Africa) observed across rolling 3-year windows where systemic liquidity surplus events occurred. Excludes standard statutory reserve ratio adjustments applied uniformly as core monetary policy.
window: 3-year observation window corresponding to the structural timeframe

cases.name: Bank Indonesia secondary reserve requirement adjustment
South African Reserve Bank surplus management adjustments
Banco Central do Brasil additional reserve requirement 2010

coverage_note: 5 named historical windows; believed roughly 8 comparable major episodes in total across emerging markets
known_gaps: Varying definitions of liquidity surplus thresholds across different central banking jurisdictions.
skeleton: Total observed rolling 3-year windows across target central banks during surplus liquidity regimes
multiplier: 5 instances evaluated from historical emerging market liquidity management episodes
validity_reason: Central banking toolsets for liquidity management evolve slowly over decades, keeping structural base rates stable.
